description: Jenny Mortgage is an Ontario mortgage agent website with mortgage information, articles, and calculators for renewal, debt consolidation, and reverse mortgage scenarios. It also publishes an MCP server that lets AI assistants use several mortgage comparison and preparation tools.
summary: jenny.mortgage exposes one public MCP server at `https://mcp.jenny.mortgage/mcp` with no authentication; the rest of the site consists of browser-run calculators and informational pages, not developer APIs/CLIs.

surfaces.name: Mortgage Tools by Jenny MCP Server
